text: WHen we say 'import' we mean we want those existing props for example, to turn into a scene that is saved. not that we want to introduce another authoring approach to this editor
resolution: Clarified docs/game/HMSC_INT_ASSET_PIPELINE.md so import means one-way capture into a saved StudioModel scene made of EditMesh parts, not adding another authoring approach. Updated the consolidation language, per-source import rules, import report requirements, and retirement gate to require modelStream persistence and to state that merely rendering old sources in Studio is incomplete.
